title: hex-tex-gen patch
description: a patch: a template and its parameters

$schema.description: JSON Schema of this file, for editors

extends.description: parent patch file, relative to this file, deep-merged under this one

template.description: Dressed stone wall: rows of stones of random width

seed.description: seed of this patch, unless the placement sets one

size.description: own size of the patch in pixels; layout values are expressed at this size

count.description: number of horizontal courses of stones (layout: scales with the patch)

heightVariation.description: random height variation between rows, in [0, 1) (layout: scales with the patch)

width.description: [min, max] stone width (layout: scales with the patch)

minJointOffset.description: minimum horizontal distance between a joint and the joints of adjacent rows (random bond only) (layout: scales with the patch)

bond.description: random: stones of random width; running: equal bricks, rows offset by half a brick; stack: equal bricks, joints aligned

panel.description: a large stone slab: room for an inscription or a switch

enabled.description: adds a large stone slab to the wall, surrounded by mortar

width.description: slab width, mortar included (layout: scales with the patch)

height.description: slab height, mortar included (layout: scales with the patch)

x.description: left edge of the slab; defaults to centered (layout: scales with the patch)

y.description: top edge of the slab; defaults to centered (layout: scales with the patch)

snap.description: aligns the top and bottom of the slab on the nearest row joints, so that no row is cut into a thin strip

bevel.description: bevel width of the slab, in pixels (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

size.description: joint thickness, in pixels (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

noise.description: brightness variation of the mortar, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age

erosion.description: hollowed joints: darker, pitted mortar shadowed by the stones, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age

bevel.description: stone edges lit from the top-left

size.description: bevel width, in pixels (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

light.description: brightness factor of the top and left edges

dark.description: brightness factor of the bottom and right edges

roughness.description: maximum displacement of the stone outlines, in pixels; when unset, derived from age (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

ratio.description: ratio of chipped stones, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age

size.description: [min, max] chip size, in pixels; when unset, derived from age (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

ratio.description: ratio of cracked stones, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age

length.description: [min, max] crack length, in pixels; when unset, derived from age (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

erosion.description: stones worn down by time: rounded corners, uneven edges

corners.description: radius of the rounded stone corners, in pixels; when unset, derived from age (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

edges.description: maximum depth worn into the stone edges, in pixels; when unset, derived from age (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

stains.description: dirt: streaks of rainwater and soot, grime

ratio.description: chance of a streak running down from the top of each stone; when unset, derived from age

length.description: [min, max] streak length; when unset, derived from age (layout: scales with the patch)

width.description: streak width, in pixels; when unset, derived from age (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

darkness.description: darkening at the top of a streak, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age

grime.description: blotchy darkening of the whole wall, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age

ratio.description: ratio of stones with a flaked, recessed patch, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age

size.description: [min, max] patch radius, in pixels; when unset, derived from age (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

depth.description: darkening of the flaked patches, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age

moss.description: moss growing along the top edges of the stones

coverage.description: share of the stone tops covered with moss, in [0, 1]; 0 for none

depth.description: thickness of the moss along the top edges, in pixels (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

vines.description: chance of a vine hanging from each column of moss, in [0, 1]

length.description: [min, max] length of the vines, in pixels (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

joints.description: moss in the joints where the stones are mossy, in [0, 1]

palette.description: moss colors, from darkest to lightest

age.description: overall weathering, from 0 (new) to 1 (ruined): sets every wear parameter left unset

palette.description: stone colors, from darkest to lightest

contrast.description: spread of the surface noise over the palette

shadeVariation.description: random brightness variation between stones, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age

paletteShift.description: random shift of each stone along the palette, in [0, 1]

grain.description: random brightness variation between pixels, in [0, 1]; when unset, derived from age (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

period.description: noise cells across the patch at the first octave (layout: scales with the patch)

octaves.description: number of noise octaves, each one twice as fine

persistence.description: weight ratio between an octave and the previous one

metal.description: metal of the plates of metal doors, and of the iron fittings

bands.description: iron bands reinforcing the door, rusting with age

count.description: number of iron bands across each leaf; 0 for none

width.description: band width, in pixels (detail: real pixels, does not scale)

length.description: length of the bands from the hinge side, in fraction of the leaf width: strap hinges with a pointed end; 1 runs across the leaf

kind.description: ring pull, vertical bar, or none; lift doors have none

age.description: overall weathering, from 0 (new) to 1 (ruined): passed to the wood or the metal, and rusting the iron
